methodology.quantile: nearest rank relative to common start; setup and socket connect excluded; client/server scheduling and HTTP framing included
methodology.paired_order: alternate baseline first and optimized first
methodology.stage_statistics: median of per-round Prometheus sum/count means, not percentiles or end-to-end attribution
methodology.request_parse: JSON/validation/match ID only; isolated HTTP framing not measured
methodology.log: debug event disabled under default gateway log level; enabled sink I/O not measured

not_measured: persistent load or competing mixed rename/backfill latency
